title: LoopAgentTeams
resourceType: Multi-Agent Delivery Orchestration Skill Pack / Evidence-Gated SDLC
purpose: 把需求釐清、Spec、Ticket 拆分、跨模型派工、獨立 Code Review、整合驗證與 QA 驗收串成可自主推進的多 Agent 交付流程。使用者確認 Spec 後，Orchestrator 在既定授權範圍內持續推進，只在需求／授權邊界改變或缺少僅使用者能提供的資訊時回頭詢問。
recommendation: 適合希望 Claude Code、Codex 等不同 Agent／模型在同一套工程流程中分工，並把『完成』建立在 Git commit、實際測試與 QA evidence，而不是 Agent 自我回報上的專案。
notes: Official repository and LAT skill confirmed. LoopAgentTeams packages orchestration as Agent Skills rather than a separate service and builds on Matt Pocock's skills for requirement clarification, spec, tickets, implementation and review. LAT defines Orchestrator / Designer / Implementer / QA roles, supports independent worktrees and cross-client delegation through native subagents or HCOM, uses one formal user confirmation point at Spec, and requires evidence-based integration plus QA states PASS / FAIL / UNPROVEN / NOT_EXECUTED. The repository explicitly notes that user-decision boundaries are skill-layer constraints rather than tool-enforced security controls. MIT licensed.
